content.title: Retail darling Opendoor plummets on Q3 miss, management’s cautious guidance

content.title: Opendoor (NASDAQ:OPEN) Beats Q3 Sales Expectations But Stock Drops
content.summary: Technology real estate company Opendoor (NASDAQ:OPEN) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 33.6% year on year to $915 million. Its GAAP loss of $0.12 per share was 68.5% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
